publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.4.1 fixes archive export and restore on Platform-managed installations: Platform migration history stays local and the receiving installation keeps its own ledger. Synthetic API and mail credentials are generated at runtime so the hosted source credential scan accepts the release without exceptions. It also includes fixes to the release installer journey and runner restart timing. This patch pins rer 0.2.66, adds no migrations and keeps the 0.4.0 monitoring features and inactive archive restore policy. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
